description: This Java class implements a log filter that passes only the message content, removing other metadata. It is part of a logging framework, allowing chaining of LogNode objects to process log messages for debugging or display purposes.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters log messages, passing through only the message text.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log message, forwarding only the message content to the next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
